faq_heading: Homes near Robert Bateman Secondary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Robert Bateman Secondary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Abbotsford School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Robert Bateman Secondary home search find homes?
faq.a: By name: a listing shows up when its description mentions Robert Bateman Secondary. Ask Jared to watch for nearby homes that leave the school out.

faq.q: How much do homes near Robert Bateman Secondary sell for?
faq.a: Within 2 km of the school, 242 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,025,868, townhomes $754,450. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Robert Bateman Secondary?
faq.a: Within 2 km of Robert Bateman Secondary the median was 23 days on the market, closing at 98.0% of the list price, with 5% of sales above the list price for the 242 homes within 2 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Robert Bateman Secondary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Clayburn Middle School (0.2 km north-east), Sandy Hill Elementary (0.5 km north-east) and Dr Thomas A Swift Elementary (0.5 km south-west).

The search below lists homes for sale whose listing names Robert Bateman Secondary. Under it are the prices homes sold for within 2 km of the school.
How the Robert Bateman Secondary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Robert Bateman Secondary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 2 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Robert Bateman Secondary

10 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Robert Bateman Secondary in a straight line (6 elementary, 2 middle, 1 other, 1 secondary; 1 independent). The closest is Clayburn Middle School, 0.2 km away, and the farthest on this list is Auguston Traditional Elementary, 3.0 km away. By type, the nearest elementary school is Sandy Hill Elementary (0.5 km); the nearest secondary school is Yale Secondary (2.6 km); the nearest independent school is Abbotsford Christian School (0.8 km). The nearest school teaching the same grades (9-12) is Yale Secondary, 2.6 km south of Robert Bateman Secondary.
